name: a namespace move preserves every test declaration and assertion

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: an unchanged namespace also permits an exact file move

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: file-scoped namespaces and another test framework preserve identity

before.Checks/WidgetTests.cs:
namespace Checks;
class WidgetTests { [Fact] public void Widget() { Assert.Equal(13, WidgetOf(2)); } }

after.Checks/Domain/WidgetTests.cs:
namespace Checks.Domain;
class WidgetTests { [Fact] public void Widget() { Assert.Equal(13, WidgetOf(2)); } }

name: unchanged imports remain part of the move identity

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs:
using NUnit.Framework;
namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs:
using NUnit.Framework;
namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: multiple tests retain their assertions in the same declarations

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } [Test] public void Negative() { Assert.That(AmountOf(-1), Is.EqualTo(0)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } [Test] public void Negative() { Assert.That(AmountOf(-1), Is.EqualTo(0)); } } }

name: a changed expected value must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(29)); } } }

name: a different tested callable must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(CachedAmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: a removed assertion must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() {  } } }

name: a tautological assertion with the same assertion count must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.True(true); } } }

name: a changed test declaration must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Anything() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: a disabled moved test must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test, Ignore("follow-up")] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: an unrelated deletion and addition must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class StockTests { [Test] public void Stock() { Assert.That(StockOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: renaming the file falls outside the identity gate

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/OtherTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: an import change must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs:
using NUnit.Framework;
namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs:
using Other.Framework;
namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: a changed helper must still flag

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { int AmountOf(int n) { return n * 7; } [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { int AmountOf(int n) { return 28; } [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: namespace-looking assertion literals must remain identical

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(LabelOf(4), Is.EqualTo("Tests")); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(LabelOf(4), Is.EqualTo("Tests.Billing")); } } }

name: moving assertions between declarations does not preserve coverage

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } [Test] public void Negative() { Assert.That(AmountOf(-1), Is.EqualTo(0)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(-1), Is.EqualTo(0)); } [Test] public void Negative() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: files without recognizable assertions cannot qualify

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() {  } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() {  } } }

name: a real deletion without a replacement still flags

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: a modification to an existing destination is not a complete move

before.Tests/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }
before.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(3), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: one replacement cannot cover two deleted files

before.Tests/A/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }
before.Tests/B/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.B { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/Billing/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

name: two replacements can preserve two separate files

before.Tests/A/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }
before.Tests/B/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.B { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }

after.Tests/NewA/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Billing { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }
after.Tests/NewB/AmountTests.cs: namespace Tests.Other { class AmountTests { [Test] public void Amount() { Assert.That(AmountOf(4), Is.EqualTo(28)); } } }
